Commentary.Commentary: So that is it from this game! Pakistan end their World Cup campaign on a good note and Bangladesh in a bad manner. Both though did not have a tournament to remember. On the 6th of June which is a Saturday and which is also the last day of the group stage of this World Cup, there are two games lined up. Two big games as it would decide who finishes on top and who would end up being second. The first game sees Sri Lanka take on India and the second is a battle between Australia and South Africa. The first game begins at 10.30 am local (0930 GMT). The second begins at 1.30 pm local (1230 GMT). Till then, goodbye and take care!

Pakistan skipper, Sarfaraz Ahmed, says it is very unfortunate they came into form at the back end but could not qualify. Admits the game against Windies cost them a lot. Further adds they though played very good cricket throughout the tournament and were good in all three departments. Mentions they started off with a different combination but how Haris Sohail and Afridi came back was commendable. Tells they have a break of almost two months and they need to sit down and have a chat. Credits the batters and the bowlers for the way they played today. Ends by saying the way Shaheen Afridi is bowling in recent times has been exceptional.

Bangladesh skipper, Mashrafe Mortaza, says in the last two matches, Shakib batted well but they could not get partnerships. Mentions they felt they could chase this down but they lacked partnerships. Credits Shakib for the way he has played throughout and feels had he not performed, they would not have played so well. States the fielding cost them in many games, the bowling is an issue but fielding was poor. Further adds batting was excellent. Tells since the time Mustafizur Rahman started playing, he has been brilliant, he did get injured but came back strongly and he hopes he has no injury issues moving ahead. Admits he is not satisfied with their performance as they could not qualify for the semis but he is happy they gave their 100 percent. Ends by saying he will go home and think about whether he wants to continue playing for Bangladesh or not.

MAN OF THE MATCH, Shaheen Afridi, says he has been working hard in the nets and with the bowling coach and he is happy with this success. States it is a special feeling for him, his family and Pakistan. Informs he asked his captain whether he can bowl yorkers, he got the nod and bowled them. Mentions the wicket was slow, Rahman bowled well by using cutters and he did the same. Ends by saying he dedicates this award to his father.

Earlier in the day, Imam's ton and Babar's 96 powered Pakistan to a above par score. Rahman was the best bowler in the first half as he finished with a fifer. It though is for a losing cause as Bangladesh fell well short of Pakistan's total.

The Pakistan bowling was top notch today! When you bowl an opposition out for 221, the bowling obviously has done well right? Shaheen though was the star as he finished with a 6-fer. Shadab Khan was on the expensive side but did take two wickets. Amir and Riaz took one each.

A very, very convincing win today for Pakistan! It was like, the Bangladesh batting line-up, which has been so good in this tournament, just never arrived. They needed to get off to a good start chasing 316 but they lost Sarkar early. Tamim had another poor outing with the bat. Rahim too did not last for long. Shakib once again was the only one who showed resistance. Das did hang around with him but perished just as the two started to get going. Shakib soon followed and once he fell, it seemed like Bangladesh had given up. Mahmudullah and Hossain played with no intent and when they decided to step on the gas, they could not find the boundaries and one by one, perished and were bowled out for a moderate total.

The Pakistan players walk off with a smile and a very nice gesture by them as they give Shoaib Malik a guard of honour. Well deserved that as he has served his country for a very long time and done so really well.

OUT! BOOM! Afridi finishes things off! 6-fer for him and he now holds the record for the best bowling figures in this World Cup. Another excellent yorker on middle, Rahman fails to jam it out and the stumps are shattered. PAKISTAN WIN BY 94 RUNS!
Shorter and down the leg side, Rahman awkwardly tries to pull but misses. Wided.
Floats it up on off, Rahman swings but it goes off the inner half through mid-wicket for one. Shaheen now has the chance to pick the last wicket in his last over.
On middle, this is worked to mid-wicket.

OUT! He is way short! STUMPED! No. 9 goes down! Clever bowling from Shadab. He sees Mashrafe come down the track and fires it outside off. Mashrafe swings but misses. Sarfaraz collects it and whips the bails off. The umpires take it upstairs to check. Replays show that Mashrafe did try to slide his back foot in,  but could not make it in time. End of the entertainment by Mashrafe.
A stumping appeal has been taken upstairs. Mash is already walking.
A single! This is worked wide of long on and the batters take one.
Floats it up on off, this is kept out.
FOUR! Deft! Flatter and outside off, Hasan goes back, plays it late and past the short third man fielder for a boundary.
A slower yorker outside off, Mash looks to go big again but misses.
Outside off, Mortaza makes room and looks to swing but misses.
A full toss around off, this tails away. Hasan looks to drive but it goes off the outside edge down to third man for one.
Shorter and outside off, this is slapped through covers for one.
Goes shorter and on middle, MM guides it to point.
SIX! High and handsome! Fuller and on middle, Mortaza clears his front leg, extends his arms and lofts it over the long on fence. He is dealing in maximums.
MM comes down the pitch but this time mistimes his whip. It goes towards deep mid-wicket for one.
Turn! This lands around off and turns away. Mortaza plays inside the line and gets beaten.
SIX! TONKED! This is fuller and on middle, in the zone for Mashrafe. he lofts it over the long on stand for a biggie. 200 up for Bangladesh.
Missed stumping chance! Mash comes down the track and looks to go big. He gets an inside edge onto the pads. The ball rolls behind towards Sarfaraz who fails to collect it. Mortaza makes it in.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
On off, this is kept out.
Back of a length and on off, this is pushed to covers.
Fuller and outside off, Mash drives it towards point who fumbles and a run is taken.
Good length and on off, this is guided to point.
Mashrafe Mortaza walks out to bat for probably the last time in his career.

OUT! KABOOM! What a way to get a fifer! What a delivery! WOW! That is fast and right in the blockhole, nothing Mahmudullah could have done there. Shaheen steams in and bowls a corker of a yorker on middle. Mahmudullah fails to jam it out, the ball hits the boot and then the stumps. Maiden ODI fifer for Shaheen. He has been a different bowler since his performance against New Zealand.
The batsman guides it to third man. One run added to the total.
Mehedi Hasan is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Shaheen gets his fourth. Half century for Saifuddin in the last game and a first-baller in this one. He looks to go after the bowler straightaway. He comes down the track and smashes this but straight to mid off. Amir takes an easy one. Once again Shaheen strikes on the first ball of his new spell. Pakistan are 3 wickets away.
Shaheen Afridi is back on!
Time for Powerplay 3! 5 fielders can be placed outside the ring till the 50th over.
Floats it up on off, Mahmudullah strokes it to covers.
On middle, it is kept out.
Mohammad Saifuddin is the new man in.

OUT! Mosaddek holes out! Shadab breaks the stand. His first. Hossain had to go for it. He comes down the track and looks to go inside out over cover. He ends up hitting it a little too straight and Azam at long off takes a straight-forward catch.
Good fielding again! Pakistan have been good in the field apart from the two dropped catches. This is fuller and on middle, Mahmudullah looks to get past mid on but Wasim slides and saves three.
Gives it air and lands it on off, this is hit down to long off for one.
FOUR! Perfect start to the over! Shorter and outside off, Mosaddek waits for it and guides it through backward point for a boundary.
Outside off and on a shorter length. Mahmudullah hangs his bat out and gets beaten.
FOUR! Top edge! Bangladesh won't care how they come as long as they come. Shorter in length and on middle, Mahmudullah looks to pull but gets a top edge over the keeper.
A full toss outside off, Hossain guides it through cover-point for one.
On the bounce! Shorter and on middle, Hossain looks to pull but is late on the shot. It goes on the bounce to mid on.

Another excellent stop! This is fuller and on middle, Mahmudullah whips it through mid-wicket. The fielder in the deep runs to his left, dives and pushes it back in. The fielder from mid on does the mopping up job. The umpire goes upstairs to check and replays show that Imam has done well.
Shorter and outside off, Mahmudullah looks to guide it down to third man but misses.
Shorter outside off, Hossain cuts it to point.
Comes down the track and whips it through mid-wicket for two.
Shorter on off, this is pushed to covers.
The batsman gets to the pitch of the ball and connects. They pick up a single.

Another tough chance put down! This is a good effort though. Mahmudullah comes down the track and looks to go big. Gets more height than distance towards the long off area. Azam from that position runs towards the ball, dives forward but fails to catch it. The batsmen take two.
Floats it up on off, this is guided to point.
Shadab Khan is back!

DROPPED! Not a very difficult chance, it should have been taken! Mahmudullah comes down the track and looks to go over mid off. He mistimes it towards that fielder. Hafeez moves to his right, then dives, does get two hands to it but spills it. The ball goes towards mid on for one.
EDGY FOUR! Bangladesh need a lot more! Fuller and outside off, Mahmudullah looks to drive but gets an outside edge which races to the third man fence.
On middle, Mahmudullah keeps it out.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
On the pads again, Mahmuduallah looks to flick but gets a soft leading edge on the off side.
On the pads, this is flicked through square leg for one.
Another low full toss, this is hit down to long on for one. Required run rate above 10 now.
A short one on middle, Mahmudullah looks to pull but misses. Wided.
Fuller and outside off, this is hit through covers for one.

Another excellent effort in the field! Mosaddek was gone for all money there. A full toss on off, Mahmudullah looks to drive it through mid off. Azam at short covers dives across and stops it with one hand. Mossadek is off for a run but then realizes that it does not get past Azam. He turns and hopes Azam misses and Babar does so.
Fuller and on off, Mahmudullah pushes it to covers.
Outside off, this is guided down to third man for one.
On off, this is pushed to mid off.
On middle, Mahmudullah keeps it out.
Outside off, Mosaddek guides it towards point where the fielder fumbles and a run is taken.
Outside off, this is guided down to third man for one.
Shorter and outside off, this one skids through and stays low. Mahmudullah looks to cut but misses.
On the pads, this is worked down to fine leg for one.
The batsman plays it with an angled bat and guides it to third man. They pick up a single.
DRINKS!
On the pads, it is worked through square leg for one.
On off, this is defended.
Shorter and on middle, this is pulled through mid-wicket for one.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

NOT OUT! He is in quite easily! But take nothing away from the effort by Shadab. This is around off, Mahmudullah looks to defend but gets an inside edge onto the pads. It rolls towards point. Hossain wants a run and Mahmudullah responds. Shadab Khan at point runs towards the ball, fields it and underarms it with a forward dive onto the stumps, he shatters the stumps then with his body as his momentum takes him ahead. An appeal follows and the umpire takes it upstairs. Replays roll in and they show that MH is in.
A tremendous effort in the field by Shadab. Is Mosaddek short? He looks calm...
On the stumps, Mahmudullah lunges and keeps it out.
Good length and on off, Mosaddek looks to defend but is beaten by the away angle. End of another successful over.
Nicely guided! Fuller and outside off, Mosaddek plays it late through backward point for two.
Goes back to bowling over the wicket. A yorker outside off and Hossain fails to put bat on ball.
FOUR LEG BYES! This is on the pads, Mosaddek looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. The ball runs fine on the leg side for a boundary.
WIDE! Down the leg side, MH fails to flick it. Sarfaraz may have spotted it late as he reacts late by diving to his left. Does not stop it cleanly but no runs conceded.
On off, this is defended onto the ground.
Mosaddek Hossain walks out to bat.

OUT! EDGED AND TAKEN! Shaheen Afridi has probably ended the hopes of Bangladesh chasing this down. Shakib Al Hasan is dismissed. Shaheen bowls it on a length and outside off. Fractionally outside off I should say. Hasan looks to cut but that shot was not on. The outside edge is produced and it goes straight into the gloves of Sarfaraz. Pakistan are elated. It is now their match to lose. End of another good knock by Shakib. His top tournament comes to an end. He ends with more than 600 runs and is only the third player to do this in a single World Cup edition!
OUCH! That must have surely hurt! This is around middle and then angles away. Mahmudullah plays outside the line, the ball hits the inside edge and deflects near the box.
Outside off, Shakib guides it down to third man for one.
Another slower one and on middle, it stays low a touch. Shakib adjusts and hits it to mid-wicket.
On the middle pole, this is defended.
Outside off, Shakib opens the face of the bat and guides it towards third man for two.
Slower and outside off, Shakib first looks to slap it hard but then seeing it is a slower ball, he guides it to covers.
Mohammad Amir is back!
Another single as Shakib strokes it through covers.
On off, Mahmudullah plays it late towards third man for one. 150 up for Bangladesh.
On the pads, this is worked through square leg for one.
Wide down the leg side, the batsman leaves it alone. The umpire has signalled a wide.
Well played! A slower one outside off, Shakib plays it late and fine on the off side for two.
Fuller and on the pads, this is clipped through square leg for one.
Back of a length on off, this is defended.
Another single to end the over! Full toss on middle, this is flicked through mid-wicket for one. 172 needed in the last 20.
Now a dot! Flatter and outside off, the batter guides it to backward point.
FOUR! The dots were building, the big shot was coming and it comes off. Mahmudullah plays the slog sweep. He connects well and it goes over the mid-wicket fence.
Three dots in a row! Flatter and on off, Mahmudullah guides it to point.
Brilliant fielding! Mahmudullah strokes it towards mid off. Imam at covers dives to his right and stops it.
Floats it up on off, Mahmudullah hits it to cover-point.

Bowling from around the wicket, the ball drifts into the pads of Mahmudullah. Mahmudullah tries to flick the ball towards the leg side but he misses and takes a quick leg bye. Successful over for Pakistan, a wicket and 3 runs in it.
On off, Opens the face of the bat again and defends off his front foot.
Full ball near the stumps, Mahmudullah opens the face of his bat and guides it covers.
On the fuller side on off, Shakib strokes it towards mid off for one.
Back of a length on off, Mahmudullah guides it down to third man for one.
Mahmudullah is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Soft, soft dismissal. Brilliant from Shaheen Afridi. The bowling change has worked wonders. The partnership which had started to flourish, has been cut short. It is a cross-seam ball and it is just behind a driving length. Das initially looks to drive but the ball comes off slow from the surface. He looks to check his shot but it hits the bat and lobs towards cover where Sohail takes a dolly. Pakistan continue to hold the edge in the game.
Shaheen Afridi is back!
A single to end! 11 from the over. Das walks across and works it through square leg for one.
FOUR! Second boundary in the over! Bangladesh willl hope the momentum changes from here. This is tossed up on middle, Das lofts it over wide mid on and the ball races away to the fence.
On the stumps, defended.
Fuller on off, this is hit down to long off for one.

FOUR! Too fine and a much-needed boundary! On the pads, Shakib works it fine and the ball races away to the fence. 186 needed in 136 balls. Also, the 50-run stand is up but now one of the two needs to go big.
Shorter and on middle, Das pulls it to deep mid-wicket for one.
Wide outside off again, Das cushions it to the deep point fielder for a single. Good over by Wasim here, keeping Bangladesh in check.
On the pads, Das gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Shakib comes down the track and looks to go big but it comes off the inner half of his bat down to long on for one.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket.
OHH! Play and a miss. Shakib is beaten which hasn't happened often in this innings. Full ball just outside off, it pitches and spins inside and misses the stumps by a small margin.
Wide ball outside off, Das cuts it to point for a single.
Shorter in length and on middle, this is pulled towards deep mid-wicket for one.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

Fifty for Shakib! Another excellent knock by him. His 7th in the World Cup. He gets there by working it through square leg for one. He holds the key for his side and they would want him to make a big ton here.
On off, this is kept out.
FOUR! Creamed! Slightly fuller and just outside off, Shakib leans into it and hits it through extra cover for a boundary.
The batsman has pushed it to the cover region. One run added to the total.
Shorter and around off, this is pushed through covers for one.
Comes down the track and works it towards long on for two. Shakib wanted a second but then Das sends him back.
Around off, Shakib hits it with the turn to mid-wicket.
Gives it air on off, Das strokes it through covers and gets to the other end.
Flighted ball just behind the driving length. Das initially looks to drive but then seeing the length is not right, pulls out and chips it short of covers.
Floats it up on off, this is hit down to long on for one.
Good running! Das plays it  down to mid-wicket and starts off quickly. The fielders are late to get to the ball and the batters quickly cross ends for a double. 6 runs off the over.
Full ball, loopy delivery, Al Hasan rotates his wrist and plays it  down to deep square leg for a single.
Eases down to mid off for one.
Short flat ball outside off. Al Hasan flicks it to square leg for one.
Tossed up ball outside off. Shadab dives to his left and saves a run for his team. Good fielding here by him.
Flatter delivery just outside off, cut to point for a single.
The batsman has driven it through mid off. One run added to the total.
Very full outside off, Shakib mistimes the sweep through mid-wicket for one.
EDGY FOUR! 100 up for Bangladesh. This is flatter and outside off, Shakib looks to cut but it goes off the outside edge past short third man for a boundary.
Tosses this one up outside off, Shakib works it to mid-wicket.
Slower through the air on off, LD strokes it down to long off and a run is taken.
Shorter and outside off, Das cuts it to point.
Full toss but Das does not take toll of it. He sweeps it hard but straight to deep square leg for one.
Flatter and on middle, this is worked to mid-wicket.
FOUR! Good shot! Knows there is no man in the deep there and picks that spot. Das goes down on one knee and slog sweeps it over the mid-wicket fielder and bags a welcome boundary.
Tosses it up on off, Das pushes it to covers.
Another tossed up ball on middle, Shakib works it through mid-wicket for one.
Floats it up on off, this is hit to mid-wicket.
Shadab Khan is on!
Shortish and on off, Das moves back and punches it to covers. Dot ball to end the over.
Fuller and flatter on middle, knocked to long on for a run.
Knocks a full ball down through mid on for one.
FOUR! Flighted delivery, full around middle, Das kneels and paddles it fine down the leg side for a boundary.
Das has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Not given a wide. Sliding down the leg side, Das tries to flick but misses. No pad there but still the umpire doesn't signal for a wide.
Slight hold up in play! Liton Das is getting some extra cushion at the back of his helmet. They are taking their own sweet time in doing that, no one is bothered.
A strong shot only for one! Short and on middle, Das pulls it hard through square leg for a single.
Shorter in length and on the body, Das evades it.
Another dot! This is fuller and outside off, Das guides another ball to point. This time it is straight to him so an easy stop.
Well fielded! This is on a length and around off, Das guides it towards point, the fielder dives to his right and stops it.
Good length and on middle, Das keeps it out.
Outside off, Das lets it be. WIDED!
On the pads, this is worked through square leg for one.
On off, Shakib once again closes the face of the bat early and it goes off the leading edge through point for one.
Loopy ball on off, LD strokes it to long off for one.
On the pads, it is nudged around the corner for one.
Tosses it up outside off, Shakib hits it back to the bowler.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Shorter and outside off, Das guides it towards backward point where the fielder dives to his right and stops it. Can't stop the run though.
On the shorter side on middle, Das pulls it towards fine leg for one. A very good over by Wahab. Just the 2 runs and a wicket from it.
On off, the batter pushes it to covers.
On the body, this is worked to mid-wicket.
Back of a length on off, this is guided to point.
Liton Das is the new man in!
Drinks!

OUT! Drags it on! A loose stroke this by Rahim. Bangladesh lose their third and they slip further now! This is shorter and outside off, Rahim looks to guide it down to third man but there is not a lot of width on offer. He ends up getting an inside edge onto the stumps. Another budding stand comes to an end. 238 needed in 196 balls.
A quick run! Shakib pushes it towards mid on and takes off. The fielder there gets to the ball but fails to collect it cleanly.
On off, this is hit to mid off. Just the two from Wasim's first. Tidy start by him.
Floats it up on middle, Rahim strokes it back to the bowler.
Another leading edge! This is slower through the air outside off, Shakib looks to work it with the turn but it goes off the outer half through covers for one.
Shorter and outside off, Rahim goes back and cuts it through point for one.
Around off, this is guided to point.
Tosses it up on off, Rahim defends it out.
Imad Wasim is on now!
A short one to end the over! Shakib ducks under it. A good second over by Wahab.
This is on the pads, Shakib looks to work it on the leg side but misses to get hit high on the pads.
Back of a length and on off, Rahim guides it down to third man and takes another one.
On the fuller side and on middle, it is worked down to fine leg for one.
Good delivery! Shorter and it is a sharp bumper on the body. Shakib looks to work it on the leg side but misses and the ball hits on the handle of the bat.
Shorter and outside off, Shakib looks to cut but misses.
Length ball on off stump, front foot defense back to the bowler by Rahim.
On off, this is pushed to mid off.
Short, Shakib pulls it through square leg for one.

Run-out chance! Direct hit here and Rahim was gone. Confusion between Shakib and Rahim here, Shakib gets an inside edge and the ball hits him on the pads, Rahim goes for the run but Shakib doesn't move. The fielder has a shy at the non-striker's end but he cannot hit the stumps and Rahim survives!
Wide! Way over the head of Shakib. Shaheen tries the short ball but he pitches it way too short. Shakib lets it go to the keeper.
A yorker on middle, Shakib jams it out.
Four! Shakib hits the ball on the up towards the long off region and it races away to the boundary. Shakib is playing very well here.
A single to end a good over for Bangladesh! 8 from it. This is on the body, it is worked through square leg for one.
Back of a length on off, Shakib defends it.
Takes a few steps down the track and Riaz bowls it around middle, Shakib looks to flick but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Leading edge! Shorter and on off, Shakib looks to flick but closes the face of the bat early. A lucky leading edge through backward point for two. 7 from the first three balls.
Another back of a length ball outside off, Rahim guides it through backward point for one.

FOUR! Welcome into the attack! Lovely timing! This is on a length and around off, Rahim just uses the pace of the bowler and guides it through cover-point. It is the shorter side so the man in the deep had no chance.
Wahab Riaz is on now!
A yorker on middle, Shakib jams it out. Just the 2 runs from the over. A good one.
Fuller and on off, this is driven to covers.
A short one and it is sharp! Down the leg sie, Shakib lets it be but it has not been wided.
Back of a length on off, this is guided through point for one.
Fuller and on off, Rahim strokes it to mid off.
A direct hit! A full toss on on middle, this is hit towards mid on. The batters go for a run. The fielder does score a direct hit at the non-striker's end but the batter is well in.
Full ball tossed up on the leg stump, Rahim tries the paddle scoop behind the keeper. The ball goes to fine leg for a couple.
Full ball and straight onto the pads, Rahim sweeps the ball towards the square leg region for a boundary! Rahim is batting well here along with Shakib.
Tossed up on off stump, the ball is driven down the ground to mid off for a single.
Floats it up on off, Shakib pushes it back to the bowler.
Tossed up on middle, Rahim pushes the ball to backward square leg for a single. 50 comes up for Bangladesh with this shot.
Full ball outside off, played to mid-wicket by Rahim.
Back of a length and outside off, Rahim guides it towards third man for one. A successful over by Shaheen comes to an end.
Outside off and on a length, this is left alone.
Mushfiqur Rahim is the new man in.

OUT! TIMBER! What a delivery that is! An absolute beauty of a slower one. Tamim was completely foxed by the lack of pace there. Shaheen Afridi is once again amongst the wickets. He has been around the 140 mark throughout this over but bowls this one down to 121 KPH. It is an off cutter. Pitches around middle and then jags back in. Tamim is way too early in the flick. It hits the inside edge, then onto the front pad and finally hits the stumps. Tamim's poor World Cup comes to an end. Bangladesh in trouble. Another 268 needed.
Very full and on middle, Tamim hits it nicely but back to the bowler.
This is angled into the batter, Shakib works it through mid-wicket for one.
Good length and on off, this is defended.
Powerplay 2 has been signaled! Now a maximum of 4 fielders can be placed outside the ring till the 40th over.

Full length ball on the pads, pushed to wide mid on for a single. At the end of the first Powerplay, Bangladesh have scored 47 runs for the loss of one wicket. The match is right in the balance. Pakistan were 38 for 1 at this stage.
This time also on the pads, Shakib works it towards fine leg for a two.
The ball is pitched on middle and it spins onto the pads of Tamim, he nudges it to square leg for a single.
Short delivery on middle stump, Hafeez goes onto the back foot and plays it to mid-wicket for a single.
Tamim comes down the track and pushes the ball to mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter delivery just outside off, played to long off for a single.
Change of ends for Hafeez!
Tamim shuffles across and looks to pull this short ball but misses. It hits high on the pads. Shaheen is appealing but not sure for why!

A mix-up but no harm done in the end! Back of a length and around off, Shakib looks to defend but it goes off the outer half down to third man. They take one. Shakib wants a second initially, Tamim too responds but Shakib sends him back in time.
Shorter and outside off, Shakib looks to pull it but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
On the body, Tamim works it through mid-wicket. They take one, Tamim wants another but is sent back.
Back of a length and on middle, Tamim defends it out.
Shaheen Afridi is now! He has been in good form lately.
Shorter and outside off, Tamim looks to drag his pull but it goes off the toe end towards mid-wicket for one. 6 from the over, another good one for Bangladesh.
Full and on the pads, this is clipped through square leg. There is protection in the deep so just a single.
Bends his back on this one and lands it on a length and around off, this skids through. It hits the higher part of the bat and goes towards point.
On the stumps, this is pushed to mid on.
BEATEN! Shorter and outside off, there is extra on this one. Shakib looks to cut but is done in by the bounce.
FOUR! Another boundary Shakib. He is already into double figures. This is on the pads, easy pickings for him. He works it through square leg for a boundary.
Now pinches a single as he works it towards mid on.
FOUR! All the pressure is released with this half-tracker! It is on middle and it sits up to be hit. Shakib goes back and pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Flatter and on middle, Shakib punches it to covers this time.
For the third time in a row, Shakib pushes another ball back to the bowler.
Another tossed up ball on off, Shakib once again pushes it back to the bowler.
Flatter and on middle, this is pushed to the right of the bowler. Hafeez stops it.
Back of a length ball outside off and Shakib cuts it to third man for a single to get off the mark on his very first ball.
Shakib Al Hasan, the man who has been brilliant with the bat so far, comes out. Needs to end the tournament on a high with another good knock here.

OUT! Sarkar throws it away. Amir bowls an easy ball, short and wide outside off, but Sarkar plays it uppishly and very close to Fakhar Zaman at cover point who dives to his right and takes a good low catch. Bangladesh lose their first wicket after a shaky start.
Good length on off, this is guided to point.
Shorter in length and outside off, SS looks to cut but ends up chopping it to the point fielder.

FOUR! Not right off the middle but Bangladesh won't care! This is fuller and around middle, Sarkar looks to play it with a straight bat but it goes off the inner half through mid-wicket and the ball races away to the fence.
Amir is doing some great bowling here. This time mixing it up, he swings the ball into Sarkar. He gets an inside edge onto his pad.
A little too short this time on off, Sarkar pushes it down to long off for one. 7 from the over, a good one for Bangladesh.
OHH! This is on off and it stays low. Sarkar gets his bat down in time and hits it towards point.
Flatter and on off, this is pushed to covers.
This is on the pads, it is worked towards square leg for one.
Good running and good batting! Sarkar comes down the track again but Hafeez shortens the length. This is pushed towards mid on for one.

FOUR! Excellent shot this! The key here was he not only came down the track but also made room. He got to the pitch of the ball, went with the turn and Sarkar lofts it over covers for a boundary. The idea is clear, Sarkar is going after the bowlers and Tamim will play himself in.
Good shot on a length ball outside off, it is stopped in the cover region.
On off, this is driven to mid off.

Edge but just short! Length and around off, this one shapes away. Tamim goes after it but ends up playing inside the line of the ball. It goes off the outside edge but does not carry to Sarfaraz who dives to his left. Both Bangladeshi batsmen living dangerously here.

Edged again! The ball is way outside off and Sarkar chases it, however he just manages to get a thick outside edge which results in a single down to third man. Sarkar is riding his luck here against Amir.
Good length ball just outside off, pushed to the cover fielder.
Iqbal plays the ball towards mid on for a single.

FOUR! Now then, what has happened there? You do not see that often. The ball slips out of Hafeez' hand and lobs towards the extreme left of the wicket. Sarkar though still goes after it as he steps down the track and gives it a real whack for the boundary in the mid-wicket region. Pakistan won't be happy with him going after that but that is legal. A decent over in the end for Bangladesh.
One more dot! This is no middle, SS works it to mid-wicket.
Flatter and quicker on off, Sarkar pushes it to covers. This is turning out to be another good over by Hafeez.
Flighted ball on off, SS defends it out.
Fuller and on off, Sarkar hits it back to the bowler.
Flatter and on the pads, Iqbal works it through square leg for one.
Loose stroke! The ball is pitched well outside off, Sarkar goes for a drive to the covers but he is nowhere near the ball.

Pakistan are officially knocked out after this single! They needed to bundle Bangladesh out for 7 but Tamim just scores his team's 8th run. Shorter and on the body, this is worked through square leg for one.

EDGED AND DROPPED! Haris Sohail is the culprit. That was a regulation catch. Amir bowls it on a length and around off, Sarkar has a tentative poke at it. The ball goes off the outside edge towards first slip where HS looks to take it but spills it. The batters take a run. Sarkar would now want to make Pakistan pay.
BEATEN! Beautiful comeback by Amir. After being hit for a four, he hits the deck hard just outside off and the ball just nips away and beats the outside edge of Sarkar.

FOUR! in the air but in the gap! A risky shot there by Sarkar! It is a length ball and around off, Sarkar, who is just facing his second ball, looks to drive it on the up. Does so uppishly but in the gap and through covers.
Sarkar is off the mark! First ball by Amir, drifting down the angle outside leg and it is flicked to fine leg for a couple.
Mohammad Amir to bowl from the other end with the second new ball.
A maiden to begin with by Hafeez. This is on off, it is pushed back to the bowler.
Tamim uses his feet but ends up yorker himself, he jams it out to covers.
Another floated delivery on off, Tamim pushes it back to the bowler.
Once again attacks the stumps, Tamim is happy to defend it.
Another tossed up ball on middle, Tamim lunges and keeps it out.
A very full ball to begin with! Tamim defends it out.

We are back for the chase! The Pakistan players make their way out to the middle. They are followed by the Bangladesh openers, Soumya Sarkar and Tamim Iqbal. Pakistan start off with a spinner, Mohammad Hafeez has the first new ball in hand. Here we go...
